header: MEASURE COPY: counts the measures of destination track (0x0C8F) -- seeks it to measure 1 (BStore_SeekMeasure, time signatures from the master track found by Seq_FindMasterTrack), then walks (0x0D1C) 0x81 beat marks per measure, re-reading the meter per measure (sub_F63749, BStore_TimeSigNextMeasure_Call's target), until the 0x82 end tag: DE = measures up to and including the one holding the end tag. Called only by SongEdit_PadDestTrackToMeasure. Basis: caller + body.

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:146192 `calr Seq_FindMasterTrack` -- W = master track (time-signature chain)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:146194 `ldw (3216:16), 1` -- (0x0C90) := measure 1, then BStore_SeekMeasure on track (0x0C8F) (146193/146195)

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:146214 `cp a, 129` -- 0x81 beat mark -> `inc 1, c` (146216)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:146243 `calr sub_F63749` -- next measure's time signature
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:146254 `inc 1, de` -- one more measure counted

header: MEASURE COPY: BStore_AllocBytesWanted := the 0x81 beat marks that complete destination track (0x0C8F)'s last measure ((0x0D1C) minus the marks already in it, after BStore_SeekMeasure to measure DE) plus (0x0D1C) for each of (0x0D4C) further measures (meter re-read per measure by sub_F63749), plus 1 for the 0x82 end tag. SongEdit_PadDestTrackToMeasure then grows the chain by that many bytes (BStore_AllocChain). Basis: caller + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:146163 `calr sub_F6498D` -- SongEdit_PadDestTrackToMeasure: 'sizes the 0x81 beat marks that finish its last measure plus (0x0C75)-count-1 more (sub_F6498D)'

header: MEASURE COPY: from destination track's saved end cursor (block (0x0CCC) via BStore_SeekBlock, offset (0x0CCE)) writes BStore_AllocBytesWanted-1 0x81 beat marks into the chain BStore_AllocChain has just grown, advancing with T_BStore_ReadCursorAdvance_Call, then the 0x82 end tag. Called only by SongEdit_PadDestTrackToMeasure. Basis: caller + body.

header: One CURSOR step of STEP RECORD, W = 0 forward / W = 1 back: first appends latched parameter events, then moves the tick (0x0E53) to the next/previous 12-tick grid point (sub_F68D8A / sub_F68D9D; 96 ticks per beat) or to the nearer event's tick, crossing a 0x81 beat mark with (0x0E56) +1/-1 and StepRecord_LoadMeasureBeat (forward past the track end it appends a beat mark, sub_F6B243); back at the chain start with tick 0 it posts message 0x68. StepRecord_CursorForward ('>') passes W = 0, sub_F68B70 ('<') W = 1. Basis: callers + body.
